title: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadSZL() that allows malicious PLCs…
description: Snap7 versions up to 1.4.3 have a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the TSnap7MicroClient::opReadSZL() function. This flaw allows a malicious or impersonated PLC to send oversized multi-slice SZL responses, causing the client to overwrite its heap memory and potentially crash. The vulnerability arises from attacker-controlled DLen slices that overflow a 65536-byte buffer during SZL read operations.
